we have proposed and evaluated a multi-source multi-view neural transfer learning framework to transfer knowledge between multiple heterogeneous data sources in the form of word embeddings and topics, where the word embeddings are pretrained from the source data and the topics are learned from the target data.
we propose to use a multi-source multi-view transfer learning approach to transfer the knowledge from the pretrained topic and word embeddings into neural topic modeling.

we proposed a new topic model, namely, the Multi-source Multi-view Topic Model (MSMVTM), that is capable of capturing the latent topics from different sources of data and different views of the same source of data.
The main takeaway from our work is that

multi-view transfer learning in neural topic modeling can significantly improve the quality of topics learned from a target dataset, especially when the target and the source datasets have a large difference in their topic distributions.
the multi-source multi-view approach can be successfully combined with pretrained topic and word embeddings to improve the quality of neural topic modeling.
the use of pretrained word embeddings in topic models can be a valuable addition to traditional approaches to topic modeling.
